Knuckles reluctantly makes a deal with Robotnik to turn over Sonic and his family in exchange for finding the Chaos Emerald that will save Mobius.
Manic, Sonic and Sonia must end their training early when Robotnik threatens the Oracle and takes a member of the resistance hostage.
Queen Aleena advises the Hedgehogs to travel to a valley of Mobius so that they can bring about peace between two contingents of the resistance that have split.
Reluctantly preparing donations to the local museum for her father, whiny and self-centered Veronica gets a taste of her own medicine when she wishes everyone was like me.
Archie buys a pair of mystical fuzzy dice for his beloved car, Betsy, and unwittingly brings her to life when he hangs the dice on her rearview mirror.
Veronica treats Jughead like an outsider and excludes him from her guest list for a pool party she's throwing, on the basis that he's different.

Dr. Claw hires Dr. Shieskopf to invent a shrinking ray gun to shrink Inspector Gadget down to the size of a mouse. Quimby orders Gadget to investigate a suspected MAD plot at the Eccentric Invention Convention.
Gadget is planning a trip on the Oriental Express Mystery Tour Train and is warned by Quimby about a MAD plot to kill him while aboard.

Dr. Claw, with the aid of Dr. Spectrum and Bert Sweetley, uses a dream beam to give the citizens of Metro City nightmares. His plan is to make everyone too tired to work, so they will buy his Dreamway machine.
It’s time for Sabrina’s wisdom teeth to come out. She doesn’t want to experience it the mortal way so she opts to have them removed magically.
Sabrina’s baseball team is on a major losing streak. And Gem is there to point it out.
Sabrina’s move to high school with its more demanding physical education classes has forced her to dash from the showers to her next class with her hair a disaster.
Sabrina is given cafeteria work for two weeks (all students rotate through). She’s cramming for a big test coming up

Friends from all over the world descend on Strawberryland to take part in the first Great Friendship Festival.
Out gathering berries one day, Strawberry & her pets find a tiny fairy among the berry vines.
When Strawberryland’s one movie theatre goes out of business, Strawberry has an idea to save it: she and her friends can film a movie to show there and attract crowds back to the theatre.
Strawberry’s cat Custard is shown to live a pampered, adored existence in Strawberry’s house. But Custard’s dream set-up is shattered by the sudden arrival of a rambunctious stray puppy.
